subject: reasoning
question: Apart from 30th January, on which other date is Martyrs’ Day observed in India to honour Bhagat Singh, Rajguru and Sukhdev?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23rd March**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Martyrs' Day**, also known as **Shaheed Diwas**, is observed on **23rd March** every year to pay homage to the great revolutionaries **Bhagat Singh**, **Shivaram Rajguru**, and **Sukhdev Thapar**.
 
• On this day in **1931**, these three young freedom fighters were hanged by the **British Government** in the **Lahore Central Jail**.
 
• They were executed for their involvement in the **Lahore Conspiracy Case**, specifically for the assassination of British police officer **John Saunders** in **1928** to avenge the death of **Lala Lajpat Rai**.
 
• Although the execution was originally scheduled for **24th March 1931**, the British authorities carried it out 11 hours early, on the evening of **23rd March**, due to the fear of a massive public uprising.
 
• The bodies of the three martyrs were secretly cremated by the authorities near the **Sutlej River** in **Ferozepur**, Punjab.
 
• While **30th January** is observed as Martyrs' Day to mark the assassination of **Mahatma Gandhi** in **1948**, **23rd March** is specifically dedicated to the sacrifice of these three revolutionaries. ***Hence, the correct answer is 23rd March.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhagat Singh and the HSRA:**
 
 
• **Bhagat Singh** was a charismatic Indian revolutionary who played a crucial role in the **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA)**, which was founded in **1928** at **Feroz Shah Kotla**, Delhi.
 
• In **April 1929**, **Bhagat Singh** and **Batukeshwar Dutt** threw non-lethal bombs into the **Central Legislative Assembly** to protest against the **Public Safety Bill** and the **Trade Dispute Bill**.
 
• Their intent was not to kill but "to make the deaf hear," and they surrendered voluntarily to use the court trials as a platform to spread their revolutionary ideas.
 
 
 
• **Other Significant Dates in the Options:**
 
 
• **13th April:** This date marks the **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre** that occurred in **1919** in Amritsar, where British troops under **General Dyer** fired on a peaceful gathering.
 
• **9th August:** This date is associated with the launch of the **Quit India Movement** in **1942** and the **Kakori Train Action (Conspiracy)** in **1925**.
 
• **15th March:** This day is observed as **World Consumer Rights Day** globally, but it does not hold a specific national Martyrs' Day status in India.
 
 
 
• **Other Martyrs' Days in India:**
 
 
• **21st October:** Observed as **Police Martyrs' Day** (Police Commemoration Day) to remember the policemen killed by Chinese troops at **Hot Springs** in Ladakh in **1959**.
 
• **17th November:** Observed in **Odisha** to commemorate the death anniversary of **Lala Lajpat Rai**, the "Lion of Punjab."
 
• **19th November:** The birthday of **Rani Lakshmibai** is often observed as Martyrs' Day in the region of **Jhansi** to honor those who fell in the **Rebellion of 1857**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Background:** The trio was tried under a special tribunal constituted by the **Viceroy Lord Irwin** through an ordinance, bypassing the regular court process to ensure a swift execution.
 
• **Legacy:** The slogan **"Inquilab Zindabad"** (Long Live the Revolution) was popularized by **Bhagat Singh** and became the war cry of the Indian independence movement.
 
• **National Tribute:** Every year, the Prime Minister and other leaders pay floral tributes at the **National Martyrs Memorial** located in **Hussainiwala** (Ferozepur district, Punjab), where the trio was cremated.
